info.name: Content + Expense + Expense Category + Area + Service + Location + Franchise APIs
info.description:
Includes APIs for content management (`/api/content-management`), expense category management (`/api/expense-category-management`), expense management (`/api/expense-management`), area management (`/api/area`), service management (`/api/category` and `/api/service` — including **`/create-request`**, **`/update-request/:id`**, and standard CRUD), and location management (`/api/state` and `/api/city`).

**Catalogue request lifecycle (rows created via `…/create-request`):** **`is_request`** stays **`true`** and **`approval_status`** is **`pending`**. On accept (`PUT …/category|service/update/:id` with **`approval_status: "approve"`**) **`is_request`** becomes **`false`** and `rejection_reason` is cleared. On reject (`approval_status: "rejected"`) **`is_request`** remains **`true`** and **`rejection_reason`** is required.

**Normal catalogue create:** **`POST /api/category/create`** sets **`requested_by: null`**, **`is_request: false`**, **`approval_status: "approve"`**. **`POST`/`PUT` on `…/create-request` and `…/update-request/:id`** persist **`is_request: true`** (middleware / path).

Use **Login** first to set `{{token}}`, then run the requested module APIs. **Create Service** / **Create Category** tests save `{{serviceId}}` / `{{serviceCategoryId}}` on HTTP 200 when `record._id` is present. Use **Accept … Request** / **Reject … Request** requests for moderation; filter **Get All** with **`categoryApprovalStatus`** / **`serviceApprovalStatus`** (empty = omit filter).

**Franchise + My Franchise mapping:** `POST /api/franchise/create` saves the franchise and creates `franchise_category` / `franchise_service` rows where **`categories_list`** / **`services_list`** are the **full catalogue** as objects `{ "category_id", "is_active" }` and `{ "service_id", "is_active" }` (only IDs in the franchise body `categories` / `services` are active). Standalone **`POST /api/franchise-category|franchise-service/create`** accepts that object shape (plain ID strings are still accepted and treated as active). **PUT** mapping updates: super admin/staff may replace lists; **franchise admin** must send the **complete** list (same IDs as stored—copy from **Get By Id**) and may only change `is_active` for IDs present on the main franchise `categories` / `services`. **POST** `{{baseUrl}}/api/getCount` with JSON `{ "type": "service-management" }` returns service/category dashboard counts (franchise admin sees franchise-scoped requested counts). Use **Login (Franchise Admin)** to set `{{tokenFranchiseAdmin}}` for admin-only mapping tests.

request.description: Use the **franchise admin** user (same user as `{{franchiseAdminId}}` when that account is the admin). Saves JWT to **`{{tokenFranchiseAdmin}}`** for **Franchise Category|Service - Update (as franchise admin)** requests. Set `{{franchiseAdminEmail}}` / `{{franchiseAdminPassword}}` in collection variables.
No auth. Confirms the process is up.

request.description: `POST /api/category/create` — **`is_request: false`**, **`requested_by: null`**, **`approval_status: "approve"`**. Use **Create Category Request** for user-submitted rows (`is_request: true`, `approval_status: "pending"`, `requested_by` set).

Requires non-empty **service_ids** (run **Create Service** first or set `{{serviceId}}`). Server sets **`is_request: true`**, **`requested_by`**, **`approval_status: "pending"`**. Test script saves `{{serviceCategoryId}}` on HTTP 200. Approve/reject with **Accept Category Request** / **Reject Category Request** on `PUT /api/category/update/:id`.

Approves a pending category request: **`approval_status`** → **`approve`**, **`is_request`** becomes **`false`**, **`rejection_reason`** cleared. Use catalogue category id in URL (`{{serviceCategoryId}}`).
Rejects request: **`approval_status`** → **`rejected`** and **`rejection_reason`** required. **`is_request`** stays **`true`**. Empty reason returns **400**.
General metadata update — **`approval_status`** omitted. For moderation use **Accept Category Request** / **Reject Category Request**.

`PUT /api/category/update-request/:id` — same required fields as **Create Category Request** (multipart). Keeps **`is_request: true`**. Prefer **`Accept`/`Reject Category Request`** on `PUT …/category/update/:id` with JSON **`approval_status`** for moderation-only calls.
`POST /api/service/create` — normal service; **`is_request: false`**, **`requested_by: null`**. Priced/active per body.

`POST /api/service/create-request` — **`is_request: true`**, **`requested_by`** set, **`approval_status: "pending"`**. Price may be **0**. Test saves `{{serviceId}}`. Approve/reject with **Accept Service Request** / **Reject Service Request** on **`PUT /api/service/update/:id`**.
`GET /api/service/getAll` returns each record with both **`category_id`** and **`category_name`**.
`GET /api/service/get/:id` returns **`category_id`** and **`category_name`** in `record`.
Approves service request: **`approval_status`** → **`approve`**, **`is_request`** becomes **`false`**, reason cleared. Service id in URL (`{{serviceId}}`).
Rejects: **`approval_status`** **`rejected`** + **`rejection_reason`** (required). **`is_request`** stays **`true`**. Empty reason → **400**.

item.name: Franchise Category & Service Management
item.description:
**Beginner testing order (recommended):**

**A — Prerequisites:** Run **Authentication → Login** (super admin). In **Collection variables**, set real MongoDB IDs: `stateId`, `cityId`, `areaId`, `categoryId`, `serviceId`, `franchiseAdminId` (admin user who will own the franchise). Optionally set `categoryIdAlt`, `serviceIdAlt` for multi-row mapping samples.

**B — Master franchise record:** **Franchise Create** → saves `franchiseId`. Then **Franchise master** folder: **Get All** (search/filter), **Get By Id**, **Update** (change name/description/contact/categories/services as needed), **Get Dropdown** (active franchises for UI). **Imports** = bulk insert of franchise rows only (no auto `franchise_category` / `franchise_service` mapping like Create). **Delete** = soft delete last.

**C — Per-franchise category & service mappings:** **Franchise Category|Service - Get All** (scripts save `franchiseCategoryMapId` / `franchiseServiceMapId`). **Get By Id** → copy the **full** `categories_list` or `services_list` before any **Update**.

**D — Who can update mappings:** **Update (super admin)** = replace whole lists. **Login (Franchise Admin)** then **Update (as franchise admin)** = must send the **complete** list from Get By Id; only toggle `is_active` for IDs that exist on the franchise’s `categories` / `services` arrays (else 403).

**E — Dashboard:** **getCount** with `type: service-management` — use `token` vs `tokenFranchiseAdmin` to compare global vs franchise-scoped counts.

**F — Catalogue requests (optional):** **Service Management** → Create Category|Service Request → Accept|Reject.

item.name: Franchise Create (Auto-map Categories & Services)
item.description: Super admin/staff only (`createFranchise` middleware). Creates main franchise plus `franchise_category` and `franchise_service` with **all** categories/services; only `categories` / `services` arrays here are **active** in those lists.

item.name: Franchise master (list / detail / update / import / delete)
item.description: Standard franchise **CRUD** under `/api/franchise`. Use **`Bearer {{token}}`** (super admin **Login**). After **Franchise Create**, `{{franchiseId}}` is set automatically. **Bulk import** (`POST …/imports`) inserts **franchise** documents only—it does **not** create `franchise_category` / `franchise_service` rows like **Franchise Create**.

query.description: Also: name, state_name, city_name, admin_name, contact

request.description: Optional filters (add in Params tab): `keyword`, `search`, or `name` for name search; `state_id`, `city_id`, `admin_id` (valid ObjectIds); `is_active` true/false. Omit filters you do not need—invalid ObjectIds return **400**.
Reads one franchise by Mongo `_id` (`{{franchiseId}}`).

Send only fields you want to change. **`contact`:** if present, must be non-empty string. **`categories` / `services`:** arrays of catalogue ObjectIds (updates franchise-level assignment; mapping documents may need separate **Franchise Category|Service** updates).
Active franchises only; minimal fields (`_id`, `name`) for dropdowns.
Each record needs **name**, **state_id**, **city_id**, **admin_id**. **name** must be unique per **city_id** in DB and within the batch. Change `name` if you get **409** duplicate.
Soft-deletes the franchise. Run **after** you no longer need this `franchiseId` for mapping tests, or duplicate **Franchise Create** with another name/city.

Resolved type **2** → totals include `requested_category`, `requested_service`, active/inactive, etc. For franchise admin users, counts are scoped to `requested_by` users in that franchise. Use `{{tokenFranchiseAdmin}}` in Authorization to verify franchise-scoped numbers.

item.name: Franchise Category - Create
item.description: Super admin/staff only. Body uses **`{ category_id, is_active }`** entries (plain ID strings still work and default to active). Usually unnecessary after **Franchise Create** (mappings are auto-created).

item.name: Franchise Category - Get By Id
item.description: Copy **`record.categories_list`** into **Update** bodies (full array required for franchise admin).

item.name: Franchise Category - Update (super admin — replace list)
item.description:
**Super admin/staff:** `categories_list` is an array of `{ "category_id", "is_active" }`. Replacing with a **short** list removes other categories from the mapping—usually you should call **Get By Id** first, paste the **full** `record.categories_list`, edit flags, then send here.

**`active_categories` / `inactive_categories`:** only the franchise **`admin_id`** user may change these (use **Login (Franchise Admin)** if that user is the admin).

item.name: Franchise Category - Update (as franchise admin)
item.description: Use **`Bearer {{tokenFranchiseAdmin}}`** after **Login (Franchise Admin)**. Replace the body with the **full** `categories_list` array from **Franchise Category - Get By Id** (every `{ category_id, is_active }`). Only change `is_active` for IDs that exist on the franchise document's `categories`; other rows must keep the same `is_active` as before or the API returns **403**.

item.name: Franchise Service - Create
item.description: Super admin/staff only. **`{ service_id, is_active }`** shape (or legacy plain service IDs). Usually unnecessary after **Franchise Create**.

item.name: Franchise Service - Update (super admin — replace list)
item.description: **Super admin/staff:** same rules as category update—prefer pasting the **full** `services_list` from **Get By Id**. **`active_services` / `inactive_services`:** only franchise **`admin_id`** may change.

item.name: Franchise Service - Update (as franchise admin)
item.description: Use **`Bearer {{tokenFranchiseAdmin}}`**. Paste the **full** `services_list` from **Franchise Service - Get By Id**; only toggle `is_active` for service IDs on the franchise's `services` array.
